events.notes: Composite scheme (NCLT Mumbai orders 16-Dec-2025 and 09-Jan-2026), effective and appointed date 01-May-2026. Ex-date (30-Apr) is one day before record date (01-May) per NSE listing, likely because 01-May was a market holiday. Talwandi Sabo Power Ltd renamed Vedanta Power Ltd w.e.f. 03-Jun-2026; Malco Energy Ltd renamed Vedanta Oil and Gas Ltd w.e.f. 09-Jun-2026 (neither was listed under the old names). An earlier draft scheme also included Vedanta Base Metals Ltd as a fifth resulting company; it was dropped from the sanctioned scheme. The separate Vedanta Property Platforms Ltd scheme is a different scheme, not part of this event. Aluminium-undertaking NCDs transferred to VAML (not an equity holder entitlement).
